Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Result 2025 Out! The Assam Rifles Recruitment 2025 was conducted to fill 215 Group B and Group C technical and skilled tradesman posts such as Naib Subedar (Electrical, Mechanical, Religious Teacher), Warrant Officer, Havildar, Rifleman, etc. Applications were invited from 22nd February to 21/22nd March 2025, followed by a recruitment rally and a multi-stage selection process including Physical Standard Test (PST), Physical Efficiency Test (PET), Trade/Skill Test, and a written examination in April 2025 to evaluate candidates’ fitness, technical proficiency, and knowledge. Now, the Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Result 2025 has been officially declared on 24 December 2025 at assamrifles.gov.in, with a PDF merit list of selected candidates now available for download online. 

Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Result 2025 Out

The Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Result 2025 has been officially declared by Assam Rifles on 24 December 2025 on the assamrifles.gov.in website. This result has been announced for the ongoing recruitment for Technical & Tradesmen posts (Group B & C) under the 2025 drive to fill 215 vacancies. The merit list PDF contains the roll numbers and names of candidates who have qualified all stages of the selection process, including physical tests, trade tests and written examination. Candidates who appeared can now check their qualifying status online by downloading the result PDF from the official website.

Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Result 2025 Download Link

Candidates can download the Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Result 2025 from the official Assam Rifles website at assamrifles.gov.in under the “What’s New / Recruitment” section. The Result Link is available in PDF format titled Assam Rifles Technical & Tradesman Result 2025. It’s recommended to save and print the Merit List PDF for future reference and verification. We have updated the Assam Rifles Merit List 2025 PDF download link below for reference:

Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Result 2025 Download Link

Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Result 2025: Overview

Assam Rifles conducted the Technical & Tradesman recruitment 2025 to fill 215 posts in various technical and support trades across Group B and C categories. The recruitment involved multiple stages including PST, PET, trade/skill tests, written examination and medical tests. Now, the final Merit List PDF has been released for candidates who have qualified all the stages. Check important details about the Assam Rifles Result 2025 below.

How to Check Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Result 2025?

Checking the Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Result 2025 online is straightforward. Candidates must follow these steps:

Step 1: Go to assamrifles.gov.in (Official Assam Rifles website).

Step 2: On the homepage, navigate to the “What’s New / Recruitment” section.

Step 3: Click the link titled Assam Rifles Technical & Tradesman Result 2025.

Step 4: The result PDF opens. Now use Ctrl + F to search your roll number/name.

Step 5: Download and save the PDF for future reference.

Details Mentioned on Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Result 2025

The Assam Rifles Technical & Tradesman Result 2025 PDF contains a list of candidates who qualified all the stages of the recruitment process. Candidates must carefully verify the following important information to ensure that their result is accurate:

  1. Roll Number of Qualified Candidates
  2. Candidate Name
  3. Post/Trade Applied For
  4. Category (if applicable)
  5. Qualification Status for Next Stage
  6. Instructions for DV Round

What’s Next After Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Result 2025?

After the declaration of the result, candidates who have qualified will move forward in the selection process. The link for downloading call letters for Detailed Documents Verification, Detailed Medical Examination (DME) and Review Medical Examination (RME) and general instructions have already been sent to candidates’ registered mobile No & email addressed by EdCIL (lndia) Limited as per the Result Notice. Candidates can also download their call letter from the official website www.assamrifles.gov.in.

Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Result 2025 FAQs

When was the Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Result 2025 released?
The result has been officially declared on 24th December 2025 and is available on the official Assam Rifles website in PDF format for Group B and C posts.

How can I download the Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Result 2025?
To download the Assam Rifles Result 2025, visit the official website at assamrifles.gov.in and locate the result link under the What’s New / Recruitment section; click the PDF link to download and check your result.

What details are included in the result PDF?
The result PDF includes the roll number, name, trade applied for, qualification status, and remarks for candidates who qualified the selection stages.

What should I do after checking my result?
If you are shortlisted, prepare for document verification and medical examination as per the instructions issued by Assam Rifles. Keep originals and copies of all required documents ready for the DV round.

Who is eligible to appear in the result list?
Only candidates who appeared and cleared the PST, PET, trade test and other required stages of the recruitment process are eligible to be included in the final result list.
